title: Thai Choux Gougere Fritters
description: Crispy fritters filled with a flavorful Thai-inspired cheese mixture, perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the low-glycemic all-purpose flour, French choux pastry, and gougere cheese.
Add the beaten egg to the dry ingredients and mix until well combined.
Add the fish sauce and green chilies (if using) to the mixture and stir well.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters until they are golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Serve the fritters warm and enjoy!
Note: If using green chilies, adjust the level of spiciness to your liking.
Also, for a crisper coating, you can chill the fritter mixture in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before frying.
